checks.note: The proposition leaves out two parts of the statement: Smith 'selected post hoc' the quarter, and the subsidy was 'big'. The contract treats both as things that must be supported, and the rationale and limitations address the post-hoc point, so the proposition commits Marcus to less than he said. The rationale, the e1/e2 citations, the dates ($559m forecast; June 30 O'Reilly piece came after the June 26 post) and the unresolved outcome all match the case.

The proposition drops 'for many reasons', which the speaker said and the support condition tests ('more than one concern'). It also adds 'Public', which the speaker did not say. The rationale figures (Gallup 31%→39%, May 4–11 fieldwork published July 28; opposition groups more than doubled across 49 states; 75 projects; June 13 concerns), the limitations, the citations and the supported outcome all match the case.

The rationale matches e1: DeepSeek fell to about 5% in Feb–Mar and reached nearly 20% by early June; Xiaomi, MiniMax and Tencent gained share; logs run through June 14; the analysis was posted June 30 and updated July 1, after the June 26 statement. The limitations correctly say the evidence covers only one platform and only part of the June window. The supported outcome matches the reviews.
